_instructions: Three lists of channels, each with a different job:
competitors   — compete for your same viewer. Your benchmark.
inspiration   — formats you want to port, even from another niche or language.
neighbourhood — channels YouTube associates with yours (they show up in 'related').
Fill them in by hand, or let the agent propose them after analysing your channel.
Each entry: {channel_id, name, notes, origin}. `origin` records where it came
List them with: python3 tools/yt_channels_list.py --list competitors
